intro: You can master Slack for media buyers on Mac by using built-in keyboard shortcuts and voice assistants like Lazur to manage your workspace. Media buyers often juggle multiple client accounts, ad campaigns, and internal communication, which makes efficient navigation of the Slack desktop app essential for your daily workflow.
tldr: Use Command + K to jump between client channels instantly.
Set up custom notification schedules to protect your focus time during deep analysis.
Use Lazur to dictate quick campaign updates without leaving your browser.
Clear your Slack cache regularly to keep the app responsive on macOS.

blocks.text: Media buying requires constant vigilance. You need to monitor ad delivery, troubleshoot disapproved ads, and communicate with creative teams. Slack is your primary hub for these tasks. However, the sheer volume of channels can overwhelm your workspace. Start by organizing your sidebar. Use sections to group channels by client or project. Right-click any channel to move it to a specific section. This keeps your active campaigns at the top of your list.
Essential Slack keyboard shortcuts for Mac

Speed is critical when managing high-stakes ad accounts. You should never use your mouse to navigate between conversations. The Quick Switcher is your best friend. Press ⌘ + K to open the search bar, type the first few letters of a channel or person, and hit Enter. This saves seconds every time you switch contexts. If you need to see all your unread messages, use ⌘ + Shift + A to open the Unreads view. This is a great way to start your morning routine.

items: ⌘ + K: Open the Quick Switcher to jump between channels.
⌘ + Shift + A: Open the Unreads view to catch up quickly.
⌘ + /: View the full list of keyboard shortcuts for your app.
Shift + Enter: Create a line break without sending your message.
⌘ + ,: Open your preferences to adjust notification settings.

blocks.text: Lazur helps you stay in your flow. Instead of typing lengthy campaign summaries, hold the fn key to dictate your thoughts directly into the Slack text field. Lazur handles the formatting for you. If you get lost in a complex settings menu, hold ⌥ + ⌘ and ask Lazur where to find notification preferences. It will circle the correct menu item on your screen. This is particularly useful when you are working across multiple monitors or browser tabs.

Slack for Mac can sometimes slow down, especially if you have many workspaces open. If the app feels sluggish, clear your cache. Go to Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart. This often resolves minor glitches and performance issues. Ensure you are running the latest version of Slack for macOS 14 or higher. Check for updates in the Slack menu to keep your security patches current.
Structuring your day as a media buyer

Media buyers often fall into the trap of constant reactivity. You check Slack every time a notification badge appears. This kills your ability to perform deep analytical work. Instead, set specific times to check your messages. Use the /dnd command to pause notifications while you are analyzing ROAS or building a new creative brief. You can set a timer for 60 minutes. This forces you to focus on the data rather than the noise.
Advanced search techniques for media buyers

Finding a specific creative brief or feedback from a client can be difficult in busy channels. Use search modifiers to narrow down your results. Type 'from:@name' to find messages from a specific team member. Use 'in:#channel' to limit your search to a particular project. You can also use 'has:link' or 'has:file' to find shared assets quickly. Combining these modifiers makes finding historical data much faster.

faq.question: How do I jump between channels quickly in Slack on Mac?
faq.answer: Use the shortcut ⌘ + K to open the Quick Switcher, type the name of the channel, and press Enter.

faq.question: Does Lazur click buttons in Slack for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate other apps. It guides you by pointing at the correct interface elements so you can complete the action yourself.

faq.question: How can I pause notifications in Slack during deep work?
faq.answer: Type /dnd followed by a time duration in any channel to pause notifications, or use the profile menu to set a recurring schedule.

faq.question: What should I do if Slack is running slowly on my Mac?
faq.answer: Try clearing the app cache by going to Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart.
